model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, diamond marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 39% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 45% at 10^3. The FT line begins at around 40% and rises to about 48% at 10^3. The IKE line starts at roughly 44% and reaches around 50% at 10^3. The MEND line begins at approximately 45% and increases to about 57% at 10^3. The MEMIT line starts at around 43% and rises to approximately 55% at 10^3. The ROME line begins at roughly 51% and increases to about 66% at 10^3. All lines exhibit an upward trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
